messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — High GPU queue growth detected in prod-us-west-2. queue_length: 420 -> alert threshold 300. autoscaler failed to add nodes. Paging on-call.
alex (oncall-sre): I'm on it. seeing lots of Pending pods with scheduling failures. digging into autoscaler logs now.
alex (oncall-sre): kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending | wc -l -> 437
tara (infra-ops): hitting burst windows on reserved GPU pool and ASG won't spin. any errors from the autoscaler?
ben (platform-eng): autoscaler logs show repeated failures: "Could not launch instances: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation" and "LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch" for nodegroup gpu-nodes-prod.
eve (prod-sre): paste from autoscaler:
```
E0321 14:03:12.123456 1 scale_up.go:287] Failed to create ASG for nodegroup gpu-prod-usw2: error creating launch configuration: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler-role is not authorized to perform: ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
caused by: iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/gpu-node-role
```

alex (oncall-sre): that matches. looks like the cluster autoscaler lost permission to pass the instance profile/role after yesterday's infra change. also some launch template version pinned mismatch -> ASG rejects.
deepa (customer-success): any ETA for recovery? multiple customers have elevated latency alerts.
alex (oncall-sre): short term mitigation: 1) untaint a subset of nodes to place smaller jobs on CPU-only nodes, 2) manual scale-up of spare GPU ASG via console if possible, 3) re-grant iam:PassRole to cluster-autoscaler role or use temp role.
ben (platform-eng): I'm checking the infra change list. We rotated instance-profile roles in the account and applied a deny statement inadvertently. rolling that back now.

deploy-bot: deploy failed: cannot apply launch-template v5 -> validation error: LaunchTemplateVersion v5 not found

tara (infra-ops): manual ASG scale attempt returns error: "Launch template version specified in ASG doesn't exist". we have drift between terraform state and live templates.
alex (oncall-sre): prioritizing manual quick-fixes to buy time.
- step 1: tara, can you untaint 2 GPU pools and mark them schedulable for small batch jobs? command: `kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu-only:NoSchedule-`
- step 2: ben, can you re-add iam:PassRole to cluster-autoscaler role with limited scope? we can tighten later.

tara (infra-ops): starting untaint on 4 nodes in pool cpu-fallback-1. running:
```
for n in node-spot-*-01 node-spot-*-02; do kubectl taint nodes $n gpu-only:NoSchedule- || true; done
```

eve (prod-sre): routing policy updated to allow small GPU requests to fallback to CPU emulation tier for low-priority jobs. will drop token limits for critical customers.

deepa (customer-success): notifying impacted customers with temporary mitigation note — letting them know we're scaling and expected 30-45m for full recovery. pinging top 5.

ben (platform-eng): IAM change rolled back: added iam:PassRole for cluster-autoscaler to pass role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/gpu-instance-profile. also created a safe inline policy scoping to the launch template resource ARNs. applying now.

alex (oncall-sre): re-triggering autoscaler reconciliation.
```
kubectl -n kube-system logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler -c autoscaler | tail -n 50
```

alex (oncall-sre): new autoscaler output:
```
I0321 14:12:08.987654 1 scale_up.go:197] Launching instances for nodegroup gpu-nodes-prod using LaunchTemplate lt-0abc123 v6
I0321 14:12:25.102345 1 scale_up.go:225] Successfully created 3 instances, wait for nodes to join
```

deploy-bot: instance registration events received.

tara (infra-ops): nodes are provisioning but kubelet shows taint still present on some. I'm patching nodegroup launch template to v6 to match ASG spec.

alex (oncall-sre): monitoring pending pods -> decreased from 437 to 120 in 20m.

deepa (customer-success): customer notes: they're seeing error spikes but not full outage. keeping them updated.

eve (prod-sre): watch for eviction storms once nodes join. adding autoscaler safety: max surge +2 for gpu-nodes-prod to avoid overspill.

ben (platform-eng): patched launch template version, confirmed ASG using lt-0abc123 v6. also removed old deny in account SCP that caused PassRole failure.

alex (oncall-sre): last checks: queue length down to 35, throttling dropped. moving to monitoring state. leaving a runbook note for postmortem: root cause = IAM/SCP deny + launchTemplate version drift after role rotation + insufficient canary for infra change.

deepa (customer-success): notified customers with update: mitigation in place, no further impact expected. will follow up with postmortem summary.

tara (infra-ops): follow-ups: 1) add preflight check in terraform apply to verify autoscaler role permissions, 2) add automated alert when launch template version mismatch occurs, 3) add a small reserved spare GPU capacity pool for burst.

alex (oncall-sre): handing off to eve for cleanup and postmortem (on-call shift change).
eve (prod-sre): ack, taking ownership. creating incident ticket INC-2026-0321 and assigning to platform and infra for RCA. thanks all :thumbsup:
